sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See incentives rather than individual shallowness

sentenceIntentions.text: Courts, archives, and well-run meetings offer a different rhythm, making room for context and time to think.

sentenceIntentions.text: As AI produces more plausible answers, someone still has to decide which ones deserve careful attention.

sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Imagine attention supported by arrangements rather than willpower alone
